plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction mandatory terms acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to an auction with the default reverse-auction ranking strategy.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply an available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Render and fill the auction pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Enter the requested delivery location where the sheet exposes it as an editable cell.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the configured event screen

steps.note: Configure the two clauses and mark them mandatory, which has no dedicated domain step.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-portal submission.
Verify that publishing reached a real event page.
Continue in the separate supplier portal session.
Open the event's auction bid sheet as the invited vendor.
Accept the mandatory terms as required by the bid form and submit a quote of 100 for every line.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer-side event page reports that bidding vendors accepted the Terms and Conditions.
